properties.name: Several sessions on one machine work the same design at the same time
properties.statement: Anthony, 2026-07-26: "I want to have multiple sessions running and being able to use the same reflow2 graph." Six concurrent sessions must read and write ONE design concurrently, without a worktree each and without an export-and-merge round trip between them. The store is single-writer per process, so this is served by one server process holding the graph with many client sessions connected — there is still exactly one writer. Reads must not queue behind each other (the graph sits behind a lock that today serialises everything), each client must be its own seat, and a client must never be able to see a partial write.
